title: Sparkly aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#e8f4ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#b8d4ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wing1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#4a8fe0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2d6fc4'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tail1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff8a5c'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff5c2d'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M68 40 L82 26 L82 42 Z' fill='url(#tail1)'/>

  <!-- rear wing -->
  <path d='M58 48 L44 58 L62 56 Z' fill='url(#wing1)'/>

  <!-- fuselage -->
  <path d='M14 50 Q16 40 34 40 L66 40 Q80 42 84 50 Q80 58 66 60 L34 60 Q16 60 14 50 Z' fill='url(#body1)'/>

  <!-- nose highlight -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='50' r='5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffe680'/>

  <!-- front wing -->
  <path d='M42 56 L34 74 L58 64 Z' fill='url(#wing1)'/>

  <!-- belly stripe -->
  <path d='M22 56 Q40 62 66 56 Q40 58 22 56 Z' fill='#7aa8e0' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- window -->
  <rect x='60' y='44' width='9' height='7' rx='3' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <path d='M22 50 L34 50' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe680'>
    <path d='M12 22 L14 28 L20 30 L14 32 L12 38 L10 32 L4 30 L10 28 Z'/>
    <path d='M88 70 L89.5 74 L93 75 L89.5 76.5 L88 81 L86.5 76.5 L83 75 L86.5 74 Z'/>
    <path d='M30 84 L31 87 L34 88 L31 89 L30 92 L29 89 L26 88 L29 87 Z'/>
    <path d='M88 14 L89 17 L92 18 L89 19 L88 22 L87 19 L84 18 L87 17 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#7fd4ff'>
    <path d='M46 16 L47 19 L50 20 L47 21 L46 24 L45 21 L42 20 L45 19 Z'/>
    <path d='M72 84 L73 87 L76 88 L73 89 L72 92 L71 89 L68 88 L71 87 Z'/>
    <path d='M6 66 L7 68.5 L9.5 69 L7 69.5 L6 72 L5 69.5 L2.5 69 L5 68.5 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
